description: This Java class `TrustManagerFactoryFactory` creates SSL TrustManagerFactory instances from various sources, including default keystores, custom certificates, and in insecure mode. It handles certificate loading, keystore initialization, revocation checking, and provides factory methods for SSL context configuration within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity services.

classes.name: TrustManagerFactoryFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating javax.net.ssl.TrustManagerFactory instances based on different certificate sources, with support for revocation checking and insecure configurations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static factory methods to obtain instances of TrustManagerFactoryFactory using DittoHeaders or ExceptionMapper.

methods.name: newTrustManagerFactory
methods.description: Creates a TrustManagerFactory based on provided trusted certificates and revocation check flag.

methods.name: newTrustManagerFactory (overload)
methods.description: Creates a TrustManagerFactory based on a Connection object, optionally validating certificates.

methods.name: newInsecureTrustManagerFactory
methods.description: Returns a TrustManagerFactory that accepts any certificates, bypassing validation.

methods.name: createTrustManagerFactory
methods.description: Internal method that constructs a TrustManagerFactory with provided trusted certificates or default CA keystore, including revocation configuration.

methods.name: loadDefaultCAKeystore
methods.description: Loads the default CA keystore from the JVM's security directory.
